title: Released a demo on Steam for a rhythm platformer - Spire Song
author: re-skob
selftext:
Spire Song is a rhythm platformer about swinging up a drowned stained-glass bell tower. You tap on the beat to let go of bells and catch ropes, and the music builds as you keep your combo. Claude wrote all of the code, made the art, and music.

Rhythm games live and die by the music obviously, and I'm happy with how it came out. I loved the initial track Claude made which motivated me to complete the game. None of the music is from a music generator like Suno. All of it is written by claude in code and played at runtime from orchestral samples to the beat the levels are built on, so every swing and catch lands on the music and the music can change tempo dynamically. Your combo adds strings, horns, choir and organ as it builds, and a miss muffles it. There's also an internal music composer that ensures all of the tracks flow together onto the beat so going between levels, exiting to main menu, etc all flow dynamically into each other so you never hear the music cut.

Demo is on Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5537150/Spire\_Song](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5537150/Spire_Song)
